Based on the image provided, here is the description of the expanded button in the right column (Drinks):

**Full Text:**
The text inside the expanded button reads **"Hot Drinks"**. Below the category name, there is smaller text that says **"Tap again"**.

**Readability:**
The category name **"Hot Drinks" is fully readable**, but it is **truncated** visually. The text wraps to a second line because the button is not wide enough to fit the words side-by-side. It displays as:
*   Line 1: "Hot Drink"
*   Line 2: "s"

**Description of the Expanded Button:**
Unlike the other buttons which are standard rounded rectangles with white backgrounds, this specific button is **significantly taller (expanded vertically)** to accommodate the extra text and details.
*   **Background:** It has a light beige or cream-colored background, distinguishing it from the white buttons below it.
*   **Content:** In addition to the wrapped category name, it features a small icon on the right side (looks like a cup or glass) with the number **"4"** next to it, indicating the number of items in that category.
*   **Sub-text:** The phrase **"Tap again"** appears at the bottom of the button in a smaller, grey font.
